rationale: R3: Prime Intellect runs a public library of task environments; Hermes Agent (252k stars) has community skill libraries; skill files reportedly transfer between tools; Braintrust/Langfuse hold datasets. A library is defensible only with private, verified, domain-specific outcomes, none of which exist yet. R5 adds that evaluating whether an outer loop improves research outcomes is an open question, but that is a research task, not a product.
author: agent:fable-agentic-stack-20261009

criterion_rationales.competition: Prime Intellect environments hub, Hermes skill libraries, Braintrust/Langfuse datasets, public benchmarks (SWE-bench, MLE-bench)
criterion_rationales.moat: Only private verified outcomes would be defensible; packs and skills are copied freely
criterion_rationales.go_to_market: No buyer for packs alone identified
criterion_rationales.network: Depends on other tools' skill/eval formats

recommendation: Drop as a standalone asset; keep verified evaluations as a property of the wedge's ledger (every run carries a verify result).
